newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil flat, supply scarcer.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil flat, supply scarcer.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were flat on Wednesday, traders said.
Low sulphur cargoes were assessed at around $112 fob NWE after the sale on Tuesday of Irish material to a U.K. player at a confidental price.

High sulphur cargoes were stable and the supply overhang appears to have cleared after a raft of deals on Tuesday. One NWE refiner bought two standard M-100 cargoes from the Baltics at $2.50-$3 over the mean/mean of published quotes.
Another refiner was heard to have bought 3-4 cargoes of M-100 and E-4 material, loading in the next couple of weeks.
